summary.text: Frenzy needle bee hives are dark yellow nests used as Gu refinement material and as food humans can eat directly.

claims.text: Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing reach the nest of a frenzy needle bee group and find the house-like beehive collapsed and empty. Fang Yuan names the smell as that of the beehive and states that frenzy needle bees do not create honey, but their hives are a great Gu refinement material and a food humans can consume directly. The fragments are dark yellow. He eats a piece; the taste is fragrant and crispy with light sweetness and a refreshing flavor. Bai Ning Bing also eats and suggests collecting beehives into the tusita flower as stores run low.

The frenzy needle beehive had been destroyed by a Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant that ate the most delicious center piece, yet bee numbers were little reduced. When the bees return and find the two eating the hive, they attack.
